name: Creative Media & Community Trust Corporation
summary: Creative Media & Community Trust Corporation (CMCT) operates as a real estate investment trust, primarily focusing on the acquisition, ownership, and management of high-quality (Class A) and distinctive office properties. These assets are strategically located in thriving and developing urban areas across the United States, with a particular emphasis on the Los Angeles and San Francisco Bay Area markets. The trust's activities are managed by CIM Group and its affiliates. CIM Group is recognized as a vertically integrated owner and operator of real assets, offering extensive in-house capabilities that include market research, property acquisition, credit analysis, development, financing, leasing, and comprehensive property management.
